# Gladmore Bvuta — Creative Brand Technologist

## Who
Gladmore Tinashe Bvuta is a Creative Technologist based in Harare, Zimbabwe. He specializes in bridging visual identity and digital infrastructure, focusing on Intelligent Construction, Brand Systems, and Next.js Architecture.

## What
This portfolio showcases Gladmore's work across brand strategy, product design, and technical implementation. Projects span venture studio building (Brandapt), mobile development (Pamhepo, Chenji), and specialized solutions (NFC Card, MCP servers).
